explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/284 with the positive resolution: f(k) = (1 + o(1))k/(e - 1), stated equivalently as f(k)/k → 1/(e - 1). f(k) is the maximal smallest denominator in an Egyptian-fraction representation of 1 with exactly k distinct terms.
